Golden Bistro

Order as-is:
- Calamari
- Grilled salmon
- Chicken curry
- Steak & eggs
- Coke Zero
- Espresso
- We close at 22:00

With changes:
- Caesar salad
  Please prepare the salad without croutons.
- Halloumi
  Ask for the dish to be prepared without honey
- Entrecôte 300g
  Among the options, skip the pasta and choose a salad or vegetables instead.
  Swap potato purée for green salad or steamed vegetables
- Beef burger
  Please serve the burger without the bun, wrapped in lettuce, and swap the fries for a green salad or a fried egg.
  Replace French fries with a fresh green salad or a fried egg
- BBQ sauce
  Ask for barbecue glaze to be omitted (high in sugar)
- Latte
  Please make it with black coffee or unsweetened almond milk, no added sugar.
